item.description:
Source91Mobiles Series
LanguageHindi
CategoryWeb Series
Release Date21 Oct 2026

Matargashti is a coming-of-age story set in Lucknow that revolves around Dhara, a young woman who decides to explore her sexuality, which creates a rift with her father. Her father, uncomfortable with her choices, becomes determined to interfere in her romantic life, leading to a series of humorous and emotional events.
